items.title: Bob Lovett Interview, 1949-04-01
items.q: No, I think that was gone when I came to Chicago.

ctx.x: Paul Merez had a place for a little while in the neighborhood. Do you ever see him?
No, I think that was gone when I came to Chicago.
Was Brunus and Tony Peretti around? They used to go in. Tony Peretti did, I don't remember having seen Brunus at the Victory Club.
